summary.text: Sarita Edgerton is a Republican state representative from South Carolina House District 34 who took office in November 2024 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She is a real estate agent and former public school teacher.

paragraphs.text: Sarita Edgerton was born in Shelby, North Carolina, and earned a bachelor's degree from Winthrop University in 1996.
Her career experience includes working as a real estate agent, public school teacher, corporate salesperson, and server.
Edgerton assumed office on November 11, 2024, succeeding Roger Nutt, and the Republican primary for the 2026 election was canceled.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she said she is married, has four children and works as a Realtor in the Upstate of South Carolina.

She listed her key campaign messages as easing tax burdens in District 34 and ensuring fiscal responsibility at the state level, strengthening personal property rights, and supporting women in choosing life for their babies.
